scope: Actual Processing JAVA2D execution of the example-owned MarkField.java using public grid, noise and palette operations. Native example edit/transfer evidence, not upstream corpus pixel reproduction or four-target certification.
runtime: Processing 4.5.6 JAVA2D, JDK17, density1, static frame1
semantic_acceptance: One retained model, 25600 records; exact point positions x=2+4*column,y=2+4*row, x-fast order.
Hash x,y,heading,lengthFactor,colourCycles before and after every paint; all hashes identical.
Record actual line/quad calls from the same example helper while forwarding to real JAVA2D; no mirrored draw implementation.
Palette case has exactly identical float endpoint data and command count, but changed colours.
Length case preserves centre and colour; endpoint displacement doubles within 0.0002px (binary32 drawing-coordinate rounding at this canvas size).
Bar centres and long axes match retained positions and base line axes within 0.0002px; same colours, 25600 quads, no resampling.
Example paint restores caller matrix and colour/stroke style.
visual_acceptance: Inspect all four images: related spatial regions of independent oriented marks remain legible; length changes mark extent, palette changes colour, bars change mark treatment. Record raw pixel differences, with no post-hoc pass threshold or claim that a difference alone proves usefulness.
intentional_differences: 640px canvas, single-octave portable noise, fixed seed/shared source with offsets, independent pitch/maxLength, fixed background/opacity, centre-anchored unclamped marks. Bar substitution is an architect-designed transfer test, not a surveyed reproduction.
excluded_claims: Processing IDE/PDE preprocessing until separately checked

review_recheck.reason: After the first four renders Sol identified missing nonfinite rejection and incomplete style/matrix restoration coverage. Tighten validation and repeat the same four configurations; no artwork or tolerance changes.
